meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能帮你处理高通量测序数据：把BAM文件转成bigWig覆盖度图，检查样本相关性和富集质量，生成TSS周围的热图或剖面图，以及比较样本间的差异。适用于ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq等。
howto.when: 当你需要转换BAM文件格式、评估测序数据质量，或绘制基因特征周围的热图/剖面图时，Claude会调用deepTools来执行分析。

say.text: 把 chip.bam 和 input.bam 做指纹图看富集质量。
对 TSS 区域生成热图和剖面图，展示信号分布。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can process high-throughput sequencing data: convert BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, assess sample correlation and enrichment quality (fingerprint, PCA), and generate heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks. Supports ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to convert BAM files, evaluate sequencing data quality (correlation, fingerprint, coverage), or create heatmaps/profiles around genomic features (TSS, peaks, etc.).

say_en.text: Run plotFingerprint on chip.bam and input.bam to check enrichment quality.
Convert BAM to bigWig using bamCoverage with RPGC normalization.
Create heatmap and profile around TSS regions to visualize signal distribution.
